_meta.purpose: Section-level form patterns. A form is an intro (Section title h1 + optional context) + a stack of titled FIELDSET groups + a closing ACTION row, all in ONE narrow centered column. `level`: 'section' = a full Section (incl. wrapper); 'content' = a block nested inside the form Section.
_meta.spacingModel: A form inherits R from its product (content/website → R = lg, application/dashboard → R = md, dense data app → R = sm). Ladder (R-relative): fields to each other = R; grouped bits (fieldset title↔description, field↔helper, choice options) = R−1; fieldset title-block → fields = R+1; fieldset ↔ fieldset and section header → content = R+2. The patterns below are written at the R = md REFERENCE (form Section headerGap 'sm' = R−1, gap 'xl' = R+2; fieldset stack ContainerVertical gap 'xl' = R+2); substitute every gap per the product's R using the table in form/blocks.json → _meta.spacingModel.
_meta.authoringRule: Components/tokens MUST resolve against components.json / tokens.json. New patterns are allowed when existing ones do not cover the need, provided they follow the spacingModel and resolve against the live registries.
_meta.placeholderConvention: <...> = fill with real content; optional trailing '?' means the node may be dropped when empty. A '<a|b|c>' placeholder is a closed choice.
_meta.refConvention: { "$ref": "block.id" } expands to that block's `plan` fragment from form/blocks.json. The agent expands $ref when authoring the Composition Plan — the render runtime never sees $ref.

form.intro.purpose: The form shell + header: ONE narrow centered Section (contentWidth 'Small (768)', canvas, spacing 'medium') whose title is the form name (h1) and whose optional description is a one-line intro. Its children are an optional form-level Infotext/Notification, then the fieldset stack, then the action row. headerGap 'sm' (title↔description), gap 'xl' (header → content).

form.fieldset.purpose: A titled group of related fields nested in the form Section: a title-block (Heading h2 + optional description) above a fields region. Fill the fields region from blocks.json (text-field / select-field / textarea-field / field-row / radio-group / checkbox-group / switch-row / consent). Stack several fieldsets in the form's content ContainerVertical at gap xl.

form.actions.purpose: The closing action row: primary submit (Brand) + optional secondary (ghost/outlined). Always last. ≤1 Brand action per page.

form.card.purpose: OPTIONAL alternative for a SHORT form: wrap a single fieldset's fields in ONE elevation-1 Card (Gesetz der gemeinsamen Region) instead of a plain group. Card padding = md (R), matching the fields' md gap. Use only for short forms; long multi-fieldset forms stay plain with xl between fieldsets. The Card is nested inside the form Section, after the intro header.
